note: FUTURE / NOT YET POTA PARKS (Brandon list, Oct 14 2026). Keep OFF the site until POTA gives them US- numbers. Lake edges are USGS NHD 24K (via KY GIS). No official land boundary published for these lakes yet; POTA will define the park when it adds them.

future.name: Bullock Pen Lake
future.owner: Kentucky Dept. of Fish & Wildlife Resources (one of its 11 department-owned lakes)
future.notes: Idle speed only on boats over 10 hp. Boat ramp off Violet Rd (I-75 exit 166).

access.name: Bullock Pen Lake Ramp
access.directions: I-75 N of Williamstown to Exit 166; Hwy 2363 W; left on Violet Road

future.shore_note: Private boat docks/shoreline permits exist on department lakes, so some shoreline is next to private lots: set up at the ramp, pier or public parking.

future.name: Boltz Lake
future.owner: Kentucky Dept. of Fish & Wildlife Resources (one of its 11 department-owned lakes)
future.notes: Named for Kentucky's first conservation officer. Ramp on Boltz Lake Rd off KY 467 (Dry Ridge exit 159).

access.name: Boltz Lake Ramp
access.directions: I-75 N of Williamstown to Dry Ridge (Exit 159); KY 22 W; right on KY 467; right on Mt. Zion Road; right on Boltz Lake Road

future.shore_note: Private boat docks/shoreline permits exist on department lakes, so some shoreline is next to private lots: set up at the ramp, pier or public parking.

future.name: Guist Creek Lake
future.owner: Kentucky Dept. of Fish & Wildlife Resources (one of its 11 department-owned lakes)
future.notes: Guist Creek Marina (concession) has the ramp; also a free bank-fishing lot at the Benson Pike bridge. State-record saugeye lake.

access.name: Guist Creek Marina
access.directions: US 60 E of Shelbyville; left on Hwy 1871; right on Hwy 1779; entrance on right

access.name: GCL Bank Access
access.directions: Take Route 60 east out of Shelbyville. Right onto Rocket Lane by school.  Right on Benson Pike to bridge.  Parking lot is on east side of bridge.

future.shore_note: Private boat docks/shoreline permits exist on department lakes, so some shoreline is next to private lots: set up at the ramp, pier or public parking.

future.name: Lake Linville
future.owner: Commonwealth of Kentucky (Kentucky Fish & Wildlife manages the fishery)
future.notes: Campground, ramp, dock and splash pad near Renfro Valley (US 25 N of Mt. Vernon, KY 2793). KDFWR listed a ramp closure for rebuilding starting Oct 27: check before you go.

access.name: Lake Linville Ramp
access.directions: US 25 N of Mt. Vernon past I-75; left on Ky 2793

future.name: Wilgreen Lake
future.owner: Madison County Parks (county park); Kentucky Fish & Wildlife manages the fishery
future.notes: Idle speed only. Ramp off Curtis Rd (KY 876 E of Richmond). The county runs the park around the lake.

access.name: Wilgreen Lake (Taylor Fork) Ramp
access.directions: KY 876 E of Richmond; left on Curtis Road; left on gravel road at bottom of hill.

future.name: Wood Creek Lake
future.owner: Kentucky Fish & Wildlife manages the fishery (land owner not confirmed yet)
future.notes: Biggest of the bunch. Ramp off Wood Creek Lake Rd (KY 80 W of London to Bernstadt, Swiss Colony Rd). Slot limit on bass.

access.name: Wood Creek Lake Ramp
access.directions: KY 80 W of London to Bernstadt; right on Swiss Colony Road to Wood Creek Lake Road

future.name: Beaver Lake

future.name: Carpenters Lake
future.owner: Kentucky Dept. of Fish & Wildlife Resources (one of its 11 department-owned lakes)
